places.name: Drury Plaza Hotel 5:30 Kickback
deals: Free beer, wine and mixed drinks for registered guests
food_deals: Free hot food from a rotating nightly menu
places.vibe: Hotel-lobby freebie, no dressing up required.
places.why_go: The cheapest happy hour in Milwaukee is in your own lobby, and the Riverside is two blocks away.
places.notes: Not a bar happy hour; it is a free hotel amenity, every evening, for registered guests only. Drury's page does not state a drink limit. The separate lobby bar (The Kitchen + Bar @ Wisconsin & Water, Mon-Sat 5 PM-midnight) is paid and has no happy hour listed. Leave by about 6:45 PM to be at doors.

places.name: Black Sheep
places.vibe: Cozy wine bar with a cocktail streak.
places.why_go: Five-dollar martinis and Manhattans on a Saturday, which is rare in this town.
places.notes: The $10 cheese board is Mon-Thu only, so not Saturday. The happy hour page says Mon-Sat 4-6 PM; the homepage says Tue-Sat 4-6 PM. Both include Saturday. Walk is about 0.8 mi, across the river into Walker's Point.

places.name: Movida at Hotel Madrid
food_deals: Dollar tapas at the bar, Wed-Sun 4-6 PM (paella, pan con tomate, patatas bravas)
11 happy hour bites priced $1-$5 (per Oct 2025 UpNorthNews)
places.bloody_or_tomato_special: Pan con tomate is on the dollar tapas list. It's a tomato bread, not a cocktail.
places.vibe: Spanish tapas bar in a boutique hotel.
places.why_go: Dollar tapas and sangria. Basically a trip to Madrid for the price of a parking meter.
places.notes: Happy hour is at the bar only. The October 2025 roundup said daily; the current hotel site says Wed-Sun. Both include Saturday. The site mentions a rooftop and patio, but they may be seasonal in late October. About 1.2 mi from the hotel, at the far end of the walking range; consider a short rideshare.

places.name: Explorium Distilled
places.vibe: Distillery bar by Fiserv Forum, built for watch parties.
places.why_go: Three hours of $5 margaritas a few blocks from the Riverside, with the Deer District's game-day buzz.
places.notes: The hours come from a 'Patio season' post on its site (Wed open-close; Thu 4-6; Fri-Sat 3-6), so they may be seasonal. Confirm before going. Its site mentions catching games and watch parties but gives no TV count. Expect World Series crowds in the Deer District.

places.name: The Sofie (Hotel Metro)
places.address: 777 N Jefferson St, Lower Level, Milwaukee, WI 53202

saturday_happy_hour.caveat: Site lists an 'extended Happy Hour 6-8 PM' but not which days; open Tue-Sat from 5 PM

deals: Specially curated happy hour cocktails (prices not listed)
$3 select drafts, $5 select wines Mon-Sat 5-7 PM (2023 listing, may be outdated)
places.vibe: Moody basement cocktail lounge under Hotel Metro.
places.why_go: A speakeasy-style hideaway six minutes from the hotel. Good for one fancy drink before doors.
places.notes: Its 6-8 PM happy hour overlaps doors, so it fits only a quick 6 PM drink. The days aren't stated, so call (414) 360-8532. Its specials page failed to load. OpenTable lists Tue-Sat 4 PM-2 AM; its own site says 5 PM to close. has_patio is false because the bar is on the lower level; that is inferred, not stated.

places.name: Club Charlies

saturday_happy_hour.caveat: Travel Wisconsin lists happy hour 'daily' with no hours; the bar's own site lists no happy hour

deals: $4 martinis (nightly drink special, per Travel Wisconsin)
Half-off bottles of wine (per Travel Wisconsin)
places.vibe: Unfussy Third Ward neighborhood bar with a heated patio.
places.why_go: Four-dollar martinis and a bar famous for serving beer in a bag.
places.notes: Open daily from 11 AM. The heated patio is open in winter. Call (414) 763-8548 to confirm Saturday happy hour hours.

places.name: Murphy's Irish Pub

saturday_happy_hour.caveat: Aggregator data from June 2023; the pub's own site blocked fetching

places.why_go: Four hours of cheap taps on a Saturday, if it still runs.
places.notes: The site URL wasn't confirmed: murphysirishpubmke.com blocked fetching. A 2020 OnMilwaukee listing also had Mon-Sat happy hour, with Saturday running to midnight. About 1.4 mi west, the edge of walking range. Low confidence.

places.name: Tropic MKE
places.why_go: Rum punch steps from the hotel. Only useful if someone skips the opener.
places.notes: Opens 7 PM Saturday; happy hour 7-9 PM falls during the show, so it does not fit before doors. Open until 2 AM, so it works as a post-show stop at regular prices. This is the old Fire on Water address.

places.name: The Wicked Hop

late_night_happy_hour.label: All-day Saturday shot special (not a happy hour)

deals: $4 Jim Beam shots all day Sat Oct 24 (9 AM-2 AM)
Weekend brunch 9 AM-3 PM with $2 off the Mil-mosa 9-11 AM
places.bloody_or_tomato_special: Famous for its Bloody Mary ('Milwaukee's Best Bloody Mary' on its site), but no Saturday discount. The $2-off Bloody deal is Tuesdays only.
places.why_go: Get the famous Bloody Mary here. It's the main event, not a side drink.
places.notes: Its 'Hoppy Hour' (Mon-Fri 4-6 PM; also Tue and Sun 4-9 PM) skips Saturday. Kitchen gap on Saturday: brunch ends 3 PM, dinner from 4 PM. Open to 2:30 AM Saturday. A Google reviewer mentions shaded outdoor seating.

places.name: Brothers Bar & Grill

late_night_happy_hour.label: Saturday night specials (not a happy hour)
late_night_happy_hour.deal: $4 Fireball shots, $4 Green Tea shots, $8 double vodka Red Bulls, $9 32 oz Swamp Water pitchers; DJ at 9 PM

places.bloody_or_tomato_special: $6 Bloody Marys, but on Sundays only, not Saturday.
places.vibe: Loud Water Street party bar with a DJ.
places.why_go: Cheap shots and pitchers after the encore, on the main Water Street bar strip.
places.notes: Happy hour (half-price wells, select calls, drafts, house wine) is Mon-Fri 4-7 PM and Sunday 6 PM-close, not Saturday. Day specials run 7 PM-close unless noted. Open 11 AM-2 AM. Expect heavy World Series crowds.

places.name: Red Lion Pub
places.neighborhood: Lower East Side / Brady Street area
places.vibe: British pub with an award-winning rooftop patio.
places.why_go: Rooftop mimosas in the afternoon, and the pub openly invites World Series watchers.
places.notes: Happy hour is now Mon-Fri 4-6 PM ($4 Bell's and 3 Sheeps pints). The 2023 'daily' listing is outdated. Hours conflict: its site says kitchen Sat 7 AM-10 PM, while Toast says Sat 3-9:30 PM. About 1.3 mi north of the hotel. The rooftop may be weather-dependent in late October.

notes: True Saturday happy hours are rare downtown. Most bars near the Riverside and Drury run happy hour Monday-Friday only. We checked and confirmed weekday-only (Saturday excluded): The Wicked Hop, Brothers Bar, Red Lion Pub, Major Goolsby's (weekday 2-4:30 PM), Milwaukee Brat House (weekday $1 off drafts 3-6 PM, per 2021), Blue Bat, Mason Street Grill, Aperitivo and Fixture. Confirmed Saturday happy hours that fit before doors: Black Sheep (4-6 PM), Movida (4-6 PM), Explorium Distilled (3-6 PM, may be seasonal), plus the free Drury 5:30 Kickback in the hotel lobby. Partly verified: The Sofie and Club Charlies. Murphy's rests on 2023 data. Tropic MKE's Saturday happy hour is 7-9 PM, during the show. No verified late-night happy hour after 10:30 PM was found. Post-show options are all-night specials instead: Brothers Bar ($4 shots, $9 pitchers), The Wicked Hop ($4 Jim Beam shots until 2 AM), and Tropic MKE (open until 2 AM). No verified Saturday Bloody Mary discount exists among these places. The Wicked Hop's famous Bloody is full price on Saturday. Closures found: This Is It! (closed March 2025) and Rock Bottom Brewery Milwaukee (closed November 2022). Walk minutes are estimates at about 3 mph from 700 N Water St; the Riverside is about 2 blocks from the hotel, so times from the theater are similar. Coordinates are approximate, geocoded by address. On World Series Saturday, expect crowds and possible changes to specials. Call ahead.
